item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00237","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C03","C17","C23"],"selected_candidate_label":"C03","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C03 is an earlier amendment to the same Executive Order 9805 regulatory scheme and supplies materially related rules governing employee-selected shipment arrangements, transportation costs, and limits on the Government's financial responsibility. The child's revised section 21 applies that established machinery specifically to an employee's choice of transportation means and assigns any excess charge to the employee. C17 and C23 are also amendments to Executive Order 9805, but their displayed provisions are less directly connected to procurement and cost allocation for shipment.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"an employee may elect to have his effects moved by some means other than the means selected by the Government","parent_excerpt":"whether the point of destination is the new official station or some other point selected by him, or both","explanation":"Both provisions permit employee choice within the same travel-and-shipment regulatory framework."},{"child_excerpt":"he shall pay the amount, if any, by which the charges for the means of transportation selected by him exceed the charges for the means of transportation selected by the Government","parent_excerpt":"The cost to the Government shall not exceed the cost of shipment in one lot by the most economical route from the last official station to the new.","explanation":"Both use a cost-cap mechanism under which employee-selected arrangements cannot increase the Government's financial obligation."},{"child_excerpt":"Transportation services, including allowances specified in sections 18 and 19 hereof","parent_excerpt":"The expenses of transportation authorized hereunder or reimbursement on a commuted basis within the continental United States","explanation":"The provisions operate within the same integrated regulations for transportation of employees' household goods and personal effects."}]}
